source_title: Black Iron Chandelier American Rustic Round Ceiling Light
description: A grand cathedral-ceiling living room photographed at standing eye-level, approximately five to six feet off the floor, using a normal lens and a centered symmetrical composition looking straight toward the fireplace wall. The ceiling is a dramatic steep vaulted gable with exposed structural beams in natural honey-toned oak, the ceiling planes between them clad in warm white-painted shiplap. Flanking both sides of the room, vertical slatted ash wood panels wrap the side walls, creating warm organic rhythm. The fireplace wall is finished in a smooth plaster-textured surface in soft warm white, with a cast limestone or painted mantel and surround in a slightly creamier white tone. A landscape oil painting in muted grey tones hangs centered above the mantel. On the mantel shelf: a simple terracotta-toned vessel and a small plant pot. Multiple large black-framed multi-pane windows admit an abundance of bright green-foliage daylight on both the left and right upper registers, with simple floor-length ivory linen drapery panels flanking them. The seating arrangement is generously scaled: two large off-white linen sofas face each other across a substantial concrete-top coffee table on a plush light grey area rug, supplemented by two swivel chairs in the same off-white linen at each end. The coffee table surface holds a wood tray with pillar candles, a ceramic pot with a small plant, stacked books, and a glass vessel. A large potted tropical plant stands to the right of the fireplace. The overall palette is cream, off-white, warm honey oak, concrete grey, and bright exterior greenery. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
